meta.name: four-color-cards
meta.description: 基于解析后的文档与用户意图，生成四色卡片——事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡，是八官署方法论的核心分析输出。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档中整理出事实、解释、风险与行动四套要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需把复杂材料压缩成结构化的讨论要点
copy.tagline_en: Distill documents into facts, insights, risks, and actions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to condense complex materials into structured discussion points

howto.what: 把解析好的文档和你的查询意图，转成四张卡片：事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡、行动红卡。每张卡片都带来源与生成方式，可溯源、可审计。
howto.when: 当你手上有解析后的结构化文档、并带着明确的查询意图，需要产出可审计的分析卡片时，它就会接管。

say.text: 用四色卡片分析这份文档
say.note: 产出事实、解释、风险、行动四类卡片

say.text: 跑 extract 阶段，先把蓝卡事实抽出来
say.note: 输出带来源片段的事实卡

say.text: 跑 propose 阶段，给我行动红卡
say.note: 由丞相府补全下一步建议

howto.what_en: Turns a parsed document plus your query intent into four cards: blue facts, green explanations, yellow risks, red actions. Each card carries its source and generation method, so it stays traceable and auditable.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you have a parsed structured document and a clear query goal, and need auditable analysis cards.

say_en.text: Analyze this document with four-color cards
say_en.note: Produces fact, explanation, risk and action cards

say_en.text: Run the extract stage to pull blue-card facts
say_en.note: Outputs fact cards with source snippets

say_en.text: Run the propose stage for the red action card
